summary.value: Avastrovirus 2, also known as avian nephritis virus, mainly affects chicks under two weeks old, causing mild diarrhea and stunted growth or, in weaker chicks, kidney damage and death. It spreads mostly through droppings and there is no cure, so prevention relies on cleaning, good nutrition and reducing stress.
